snapshots.noSelection: Select a snapshot to see its text.
snapshots.deleteBody: This copy is removed for good.
snapshots.deleteAllBody: Every copy is removed for good.

snapshots.copyFailed: The snapshot could not be copied. Try again.
snapshots.deleteFailed: Snapshots could not be deleted. Try again.

records.loadFailed: The records could not be read.
records.detailFailed: This record could not be read.
records.noSelection: Select a record to see everything it holds.
about.title: About QuickDeck
about.tagline: Write in several plain-text panes side by side, and bring back earlier text from automatic snapshots.
toast.themeFailed: The theme could not be applied. Try saving it again in Settings.
toast.languageFailed: The menu bar language could not be changed. Try saving it again in Settings.
toast.zoomFailed: Zoom could not be applied. Try changing zoom again.
toast.topmostFailed: Always on top could not be updated. Try changing it again.
toast.closeFailed: QuickDeck could not close the window. Try closing it again.
toast.closeUnprotected: QuickDeck could not protect unsaved changes during window close. Save your work before quitting.
toast.lastPane: At least one pane must remain.
toast.nonEmptyPane: Only empty panes can be deleted.
toast.snapshotFailed: The snapshot wasn’t saved. Your pane content is still open.
toast.recordsFailed: The records window could not be opened.
saveError.title: QuickDeck couldn't save your data
saveError.autosave: Your latest changes remain open. Free some storage or restore access to the data folder, then try again.
saveError.panesNewer: The pane text file at {path} uses a newer format ({version}) and was left unchanged. Your latest changes remain open. Update QuickDeck before saving to this file.
saveError.onClose: QuickDeck did not quit, so your latest changes are still open. Free some storage or restore access to the data folder, then retry. If you quit anyway, the changes that were not saved will be lost.
settingsReset.title: A Settings File Was Reset
settingsReset.body: Your settings file (config.json) could not be read, so QuickDeck moved it to {path} and started with default settings. Your pane text is untouched.
settingsNewer.title: Settings From a Newer Version
settingsNewer.body: Your settings file (config.json) was written by a newer version of QuickDeck and has been left exactly in place. QuickDeck is using its default settings, and changes to settings will not be saved. Update QuickDeck to use your saved settings.
settingsSetAside.title: A Settings File Was Set Aside
settingsSetAside.body: Your settings file (config.json) could not be read, so QuickDeck moved it to {path}. Your current settings stay in use and are saved as usual.
panesSetAside.title: The Pane Text File Was Set Aside
panesSetAside.body: Your pane text file (panes.json) was moved to {path}. QuickDeck started with one empty pane.
load.title: QuickDeck couldn't prepare saved data
load.hint: To protect your existing data, QuickDeck will not save changes in this state. Quit the app, repair or move {path}, then relaunch.
load.hintDataFolder: To protect your existing data, QuickDeck will not save changes in this state. Its data folder is {folder} in your home folder, or the folder named by {envVar}, if that variable is set. Quit the app, make sure the data folder is available, then relaunch.
load.setAside: Set the file aside and start fresh
load.unknown: Unknown error while loading saved data.
load.failed: QuickDeck could not read its saved data. The diagnostic details are in the log.
load.panesUnreadable: Your pane text file (panes.json) could not be read and has been left exactly where it is. Check that the data folder is available and that QuickDeck has access, then try again. Diagnostic details are in the log.
load.panesDamaged: Your pane text file (panes.json) is damaged and has been left exactly where it is. Diagnostic details are in the log.
load.panesNewer: Your pane text file (panes.json) was written by a newer version of QuickDeck (format {version}) and has been left exactly in place. Update QuickDeck to open it.
load.snapshotsNewer: Your snapshot store (snapshots.sqlite3) was written by a newer version of QuickDeck (format {version}) and has been left exactly in place. Update QuickDeck to open it.
load.setAsideFailed: QuickDeck could not finish setting aside the pane text file. Check the files named here before trying again.
load.settingsSetAside: The unreadable settings file was moved to {path}.
load.panesSetAside: The damaged pane text file was moved to {path}.
crash.title: QuickDeck could not keep this window open
crash.body: Reload the window to recover. Your saved decks and snapshots are unchanged.
